Outcome_variable.evidence_source: [/page/15/Text/7] Subjective well-being is another important life outcome. Teachers, as central socializing persons in adolescents' lives, might influence their students' subjective well-being through their expectations. Whereas there were no expectancy effects on mood, there was a significant effect of German teachers' judgments on life satisfaction.
